profile.headline: Full stack web developer with specialty in e-commerce

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Develops innovative tools and features to enhance both public-facing and internal web applications. Participates in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) projects by implementing A/B tests to improve user experience and drive engagement. Integrates website with third-party applications to expand functionality and streamline operations. Build robust APIs using Node.js and MySQL to support seamless data exchange and efficient back-end processes.

positions.title: Event Marketing Specialist
positions.description: Promotes Shelter Distilling and products at local events including Party on June Mountain, Mammoth Festival Of Beers & Bluesaplooza, Mammoth Rock N Rye, and June Lake Autumn Beer Fest.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Uses the latest cloud technologies and database platforms to build complex applications that are blazing fast and highly-scalable utilizing React, C# and .ASP.NET Core.
Works with the business team to develop new and better ways to solve problems in the real estate, lending and closing-services industry.

positions.title: Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
Remote full-stack web development course with a focus on front-end foundations, asynchronous web apps, client-side programming with React and server-side programming with Node and Postgres.

Notable Projects:

PowNow - HTML, CSS, JS and jQuery
• POW NOW is a web application that helps users pick the best ski resort for a spontaneous ski vacation by combining flight data with current snowfall at select ski resorts.
• POW NOW makes an API request to World Weather Online and to SkyScanner Flight Search then displays a list of ski resorts with their current snowfall level and flight price, helping the user decide where they should go ski.

positions.title: Bike Park Instructor
positions.description: Worked with both first time and experienced riders focusing on skill building.

positions.title: Reservations Manager
positions.description:
Led a staff of 30 with 5 delivery vehicles to perform all daily operations.
Created client reservations and closed sales while providing excellent customer service.
Sent invoices and collected payments.
Used CRM software to records notes, special requests and equipment history into each customer’s profile.
Added content to social media accounts and boosted social media activity.

company.name: BLACK TIE SKI RENTALS OF MAMMOTH LAKES, CA INC

positions.title: Front End Associate
positions.description:
Demonstrated ability to work and multitask in a fast paced environment.
Greeted customers, explained unique ordering process, collected orders and payment. 
Reconciled cash drawer at close.
Networked with rock climbers from all over the world. Recommend the best crags within the Red River Gorge based on individual skill level, experience, weather, etc.

company.name: Miguel's Pizza and Rock Climb Shop

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description:
Achieved 90-100% occupancy of 188 rental properties through online marketing, and updated website with any available units.
Managed maintenance staff to ensure all properties are well maintained.
Maintained all accounting and financials for five different partnerships within the company including accounts payable, payroll and submitting all federal, state, & local tax reports and payments.

positions.title: Marketing Contractor
positions.description:
Created comprehensive marketing plan and implementation strategies for startup business including website content, social media and promotional events.
Authored initial email newsletter via MailChimp and set up templates for future use.

positions.title: Leasing and Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
Contributed to the re-branding of Barclay Place by assisting with updates to website, advertisements and administrative processes which increased walk-in traffic by 70% from 2013 to 2014.
Created competitive analysis by conducting market surveys and analyzed different marketing strategies used.
Showed apartments to prospective residents, conducted follow ups, and closed sales.
Addressed tenant complaints and provided excellent customer service to ensure resident retention.

positions.title: Marketing Coordinator
positions.description:
Wrote effective website copy, header tags and meta descriptions for search engine optimization.
Assisted in analysis of Google AdWords
Created and maintained client relationships by providing individualized marketing services.
Created, authored and designed email newsletter using MailChimp.
Analyzed new products, pricing and profit margins.
Quoted and placed orders.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
Operated cash register being accountable for balanced till.
Provided premier customer service to each customer.
Resolved customer complaints.

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Created and distributed promotional materials for FSU athletic events using Adobe Photoshop.
Assisted in game day marketing promotions.
Sold football season tickets to local community college students.
Worked with local businesses to plan block party events before every home football game. 
Used social media strategies to connect with students, alumni and fans.

positions.title: Assistant Project Director
positions.description:
Assisted in development of project reports by evaluating survey and interview data.
Assisted with creation and distribution of internet surveys using Survey System.
Prepared survey results and focus group transcripts for analysis.
